title: News Summarization and Evaluation in the Era of GPT-3

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing generated summaries for abstractiveness (using the percentage of novel n-grams) and specificity (number of named entities per 100 words) to measure how closely fine-tuned models reflect the extractive, lead-biased nature of their source training datasets compared to zero-shot models.

Calculating the Pearson correlation between the difference in summary length and the difference in human annotator preference scores (votes) to investigate whether human evaluators exhibit a bias toward longer text when judging summary quality.
